loss: mean of four patient full-target mean-token NLL including EOS; no auxiliary objectives

prompts.A: Does this chest radiograph contain lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia? Answer with exactly one label: no or yes.
prompts.L: Locate any lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia in this chest radiograph. Return only a JSON list of bounding boxes [[x1,y1,x2,y2],...], with coordinates normalized to 0–1000. Return [] when no target finding is visible.

selection: sort case_id within each stratum; one numpy.default_rng(17), positive permutation then negative; first16 Fit, next16 Ref; no scores or AI eligibility
schedule: each update positive,negative,positive,negative; class queues follow frozen Fit selection order and repeat without reshuffle; every Fit patient exactly32 exposures
generation: historical greedy, no forced nonempty, no beam search or cap extension
teacher_score: GT and empty sequences, with and without EOS; no existence-probability interpretation
token_span_policy: verified tokenizer offsets, mutually exclusive divergence/digits/structure/mixed/EOS; divergence overrides character category; offsets must reproduce exact ASCII target; unknown if unavailable
budget_policy: shared GPU-worker wall time, cumulative2hours; three fixed frozen diagnoses may run in parallel, unique L1 singleGPU256steps; protect L1 and checkpoint Fit/Ref evaluations; no extra measurements or model changes
train_image_inputs: unannotated original image only; no labels, GT boxes, overlays or AI review in question
